measurement.statistic: Arithmetic mean of the two candidate per-run sample medians, in nanoseconds (also their median).
measurement.scope: Per-row source snapshots: complete 129-ID coverage at 6b41d0c3, eight paired execution cases from ea8827d7, and three UPDATE pairs from 0f9362cf. This is not a full-suite run at the latest source.
measurement.uncertainty: Each run retains its own Criterion 95% median interval. No pooled confidence interval or aggregate speedup across rows is claimed; within-role drift is retained.
